## History

Richard Keith was the benefactor of [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) who established a trust fund for the children. He subsequently died of consumption. His death, and the financial provision he left behind, ensured that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) were able to remain permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P3](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0003), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P5](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0005), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), +20 more_
